claims.content: The Auctioneer opens the Auction Admin Main Menu page to initiate reviewing SKU auction performance.
The Auctioneer opens the Auction Admin Main Menu page to access system functions.
From the Auction Administration Main Menu, the Auctioneer selects 'SKU History' via the 'GO' button under the Administration Menu.
The Auctioneer enters the Product ID and clicks on 'Go.'

The system displays the search results in two sections: a Top Section showing product details (ID, description, type, cost, price, image, auction history summary, quantities) and a Bottom Section displaying detailed auction history data on separate lines.

The system displays a list of performance metrics for the reviewed SKU, including Gross Product Sales, Total Product cost, Product Gross Margin (with negative values in red), Average Price Point, Total Auctions Scheduled, Churn Rate (calculated as auctions scheduled minus auctions won, divided by auctions scheduled), Unique SKUs, Unique Winners, Total # of Bidders, Total Bids on All Won, Average Bids per Auction Won, Gross Sales per Unique Customer, Cancelled Orders, New Registrations, and New Customers.
The Auctioneer reviews the selected SKU's auction history and performance metrics, including scheduled sales, churn rate, and bid-related results.

claims.content: Diverges from Step 1: instead of opening the Auction Admin Main Menu, the Auctioneer may already be engaged in a related workflow such as Customer History Page or View/Edit Scheduled Auctions and pivot directly to SKU review without returning to the main menu.

Diverges from Step 3: instead of entering a Product ID, the Auctioneer may search for customer records by Customer Email Address, Customer Home Phone, or Customer Name (last, first); the system then displays matching customer records with GO links under Bid History and Order History, which the Auctioneer can use to view item numbers, dates, amounts, statuses, and winning bids that constitute SKU-specific auction performance data.

Diverges from Step 4: from the Bottom Section auction history list, the Auctioneer may click the Winner / High Bidder link to view that customer's individual history page, providing a drill-down into specific bidder details while reviewing the SKU's past bid results.

Diverges from Step 4: while the search results are displayed, the Auctioneer can rearrange item attribute columns from their default settings, customizing the view without changing the SKU auction performance review outcome.
